links.comparator_used: Generic prompt (prompt 1) and prompt calibrated for content enhancement and personalization without bias mitigation (prompt 2)
links.outcome: Gender bias in generated medication instructions (and adequacy scores)
links.effect: Gender bias found with prompts 1 and 2; prompt 3 (bias mitigation) was bias-free. Adequacy scores for prompt 3 outperformed prompts 1 and 2; full or partial acceptability in 94.3% of texts with prompt 3.
links.quote: Gender bias was found in our closed-source LLM's output for the first and second prompts, with the third one being bias-free.
